description: A test patient, whom the core leaves out, has a general anaesthetic with a blood pressure on its record.

expectations.says: The core writes no person for the test patient.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS people FROM omop.person p WHERE p.person_source_value = '990001311'

expectations.says: The anaesthesia layer writes no visit detail for the test patient's anaesthetic.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS visit_details FROM omop.visit_detail vd WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990001331'
